tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Page canvas (`--color-bg-primary`, `bg-bg-primary`): body, the sticky nav, the mobile drawer, form inputs at rest. Text on it is `text-primary` (17.8:1).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Ink (`--color-text-primary`): all body text, every 4px brutal border, every hard shadow, the dark section bands (About, footer) and the dark CTA fill. On `bg-primary` 17.8:1, on `white` 18.7:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised white: the contact section ground, social icon buttons, tech tags, the card Code button, inputs on focus. Also text on `text-primary` bands (18.7:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal orange (`--color-accent`): the logo dot, nav hover underline, hero lede bar, the 'Works.' / 'Epic.' heading words, the Send Message and mobile Menu fills, GymBro's card, the '25' stat. As TEXT it only passes at 24px+ or 19px bold: 3.35:1 on `bg-primary`, 3.53:1 on `white` (flagged — nav hover text at 18px and the 16px 'Menu' label in white miss AA). `text-primary` on it passes (5.3:1); on `text-primary` it passes (5.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Electric cyan (PRD `--color-accent-cyan`; a literal `#00e5ff` in code): the 'Dev' word on the dark About band (12.2:1 on `text-primary`), the contributions stat tile, Tralla's card, the hero background blob. Fill under `text-primary` text (12.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-yellow
tokens.usage: Amber yellow (PRD `--color-accent-yellow`; a literal `#facc15`): the '2019' stat tile, Froots' card. Fill under `text-primary` text (12.2:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Purple (PRD `--color-accent-purple`; a literal `#a855f7`): Distill's card only. Fill under `text-primary` text (4.73:1, passes AA at 16px+; keep card copy medium weight or bolder).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero h1: `text-6xl md:text-8xl lg:text-9xl font-bold uppercase leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter`. 60px base, 96px md, 128px lg. The outlined word uses `text-transparent text-stroke-robust`.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Showcase h2: `text-6xl md:text-8xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter` (60px → 96px). Last word in `accent`.

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: About / Contact h2: `text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold uppercase` (48px → 72px). One accent word.

styles.name: heading-card
styles.usage: Project card h3: `text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold uppercase leading-tight tracking-tight` (30px → 36px).

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: Wordmark: `text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter` (24px → 30px), dot in `accent`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Hero kicker: `text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold uppercase tracking-widest` (20px → 24px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Full-stack software engineer dedicated to building dependable systems.
styles.usage: Hero intro: `text-xl md:text-2xl font-medium`, inside `border-l-8 border-[#ff3e00] pl-6`, max-w-2xl.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I've been coding since 2019, specializing in full-stack web development.
styles.usage: Section paragraphs: `text-xl leading-relaxed font-medium` (About). The contact intro uses the same size at `font-bold`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Trello-like Kanban board application made in Angular.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Desktop nav links: `text-lg font-bold`. The mobile drawer uses `text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide` (20px, 0.025em).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Large CTAs: `text-xl font-bold uppercase` (View Work, Send Message).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Card actions, mobile Menu, form labels base size: `font-bold uppercase`. Form labels add `tracking-wider` (0.05em).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tech tags: `text-sm font-bold uppercase` in a white brutal box.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Blog addition: inline and block code in the system mono stack (Tailwind `font-mono`). The site ships no mono web font.

tokens.usage: Everything: cards, buttons, inputs, tags, portrait. The style has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: shadow-brutal-sm

tokens.name: shadow-brutal-press

tokens.name: shadow-none
